title: CISA Catalog of Known Exploited Vulnerabilities

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: lighttpd versions before 1.4.50 contain a path traversal vulnerability in mod_alias that allows attackers to read files outside the document root.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: OpenSSH Signal Handler Race Condition Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: OpenSSH server (sshd) contains a signal handler race condition that may allow unauthenticated remote code execution as root on glibc-based Linux systems (versions 8.5p1 to 9.7p1).
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache HTTP Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A flaw was found in a change made to path normalization in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49. An attacker could use a path traversal attack to map URLs to files outside the expected document root.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Microsoft Windows SMBv1 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: The SMBv1 server in Microsoft Windows allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted packets (EternalBlue).

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for sensitive information disclosure when configured as a Gateway or AAA virtual server.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Arbitrary File Read Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Pulse Connect Secure contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability.
